가시 박힌 사슬로 감아 당겼다: wrapped you in barbed chains and pulled
Its armor is solid mana stone. It never lingers, soon fading into the dark.
Its plate is solid mana stone. It does not linger.
Mana stone has crystallized on its cap. It scatters spores and slips into cracks in the wall.
An apostle of the One God, seeped in through a crack in the ward. Eyes stare open on every wing.
굶주린 망령들이 서로를 삼키다 하나로 뭉쳤다. 기아/풍요의 신이 남긴 가: Starving wraiths devoured one another until they fused into one. The deepest trace left by the God of Famine/Plenty. An old bowl hangs at its waist.
굶주림이 형체를 얻은 것. 먹어도 먹어도 배가 차지 않는다. 균열이 숨을: Hunger given form. However much it eats, it is never full. It crawls out only when the Rift draws breath.
균열 맨 밑바닥, 틈 위 바위에 뿌리박은 거대한 입. 붙잡은 것을 깨물고: A colossal mouth rooted to the rock above a chasm at the very bottom of the Rift. It crushes what it seizes, its tentacles grow back, and when cornered it swallows in a frenzy.
They live clinging to the walls of the Rift. Their echoes scramble the mind.
It lives by gnawing gold veins. It soon flees to the shaft ceiling.
긴 다리로 밀쳐냈다: shoved you with its long legs
Its feathers are mana stone. It soon flees into the sky.
Its shell is a mana stone vein. Hold out too long and it burrows into the rock.
Its shell is solid mana stone. Hold out too long and it hides inside.
Still fighting a war that never ended. Its battle cry freezes the spine.
끝나지 않은 전쟁의 잔해를 치우는 거대한 것. 머무는 자도 잔해로 여긴다: A colossal thing that clears away the wreckage of the unending war. It counts those who linger as wreckage too.
끝없는 입을 벌려 덮쳤다: lunged with its endless maw agape
녹슨 갈퀴 같은 팔로 쓸어 냈다: swept with arms like rusted rakes
녹슨 광차들을 이은 몸으로 밀어붙였다: rammed with a body of linked rusted mine carts
녹슨 광차를 여럿 이어 붙인 몸으로 레일을 따라 온다. 계단 아래까지는: A body of many rusted mine carts strung together, it comes along the rails. It will not follow you down the stairs.
녹슨 입을 벌려 덮쳤다: lunged with its rusted mouth agape
녹슨 창과 뼈 더미로 내리쳤다: smashed down with a mass of rusted spears and bone
The whole eye is mana stone. It soon closes and vanishes.
Slow but tough. Its slime eats away iron.
다리에 달라붙어 피를 빨았다: latched onto your leg and sucked blood
독 묻은 혀를 휘둘렀다: lashed out with a venomous tongue
Its carapace is one whole mana stone vein. Hold out too long and it digs into the ground.
Ore embedded in its back turns blades. Slow, but rich in mana stones.
떠다니는 주교관과 제의. 속은 비었다. 3라운드마다 밀랍 신도를 불러 모: A floating mitre and vestments, empty within. Every 3 rounds it summons Wax Faithful. An inverted holy symbol hangs at its neck.
떨어진 것들을 쓸어 담는 손으로 훑었다: raked with hands that gather up the fallen
A hand that clears away what has fallen. Whatever lingers long at the bottom, it counts as fallen too. It will not follow you to the floor below.
뜨거운 향 연기를 끼얹었다: doused you in scalding incense smoke
The rusted mine cart on the rails is really a mouth. It carries gunpowder in its belly.
마석 깃으로 그었다: slashed with a mana stone pinion
마석 껍질로 들이받았다: rammed with its mana stone shell
마석 뿔로 들이받았다: rammed with a mana stone horn
It swallowed mana stones and its belly glows. Timid, it flees quickly.
Its blows make you breathe in spores.
Headless armor and an axe. It goes for the neck.
머리 없는 갑옷이 도끼를 내리찍었다: the headless armor brought its axe down
It leads the pack. Wolves at its side strike more accurately.
물에 불은 쥐들이 떼 지어 헤엄친다. 물리면 열병이 옮는다. 물속에서는: Waterlogged rats swimming in a swarm. Their bite spreads fever. Hard to shake off in the water.
물에 잠긴 사원 바닥을 기어 다니며 머무는 것을 모두 쓸어 간다. 계단: It crawls the floor of the drowned temple, sweeping away all that lingers. It will not follow you down the stairs.
A submerged guardian statue. Until it moves, it looks like any other statue.
물에 잠긴 신상 전체에 뿌리를 내린 곰팡이 군체. 3라운드마다 포자를 터: A fungal colony rooted through an entire submerged idol. Every 3 rounds it bursts spores, and with mold at its side it regrows through its roots.
물에 잠긴 종탑의 따개비 군체. 종소리가 머릿속을 헤집는다. 녹청 종을: A barnacle colony from a drowned bell tower. Its tolling claws through the mind. It cradles a verdigris bell.
Head of the Inquisitors, who has hunted heretics to the temple at the Labyrinth's end.
미궁은 한곳에 오래 머무는 것을 싫어한다. 층을 치우러 온다. 계단 아래: The Labyrinth hates anything that stays too long in one place. It comes to clear the floor. It will not chase you down the stairs.
An eye risen from the bottomless chasm. Meet its gaze and everything turns futile.
It eats its way through rock. Where it falls, the ground sometimes caves in.
It lives upside down on cliff faces. It shakes your footing loose to make you fall.
벽 틈에서 뻗어 나와 붙잡는다. 어둠이 짙을수록 정확하다. 벼랑 위에서: It reaches out from cracks in the wall to seize. The deeper the dark, the surer its grip. Caught on a ledge, you are dragged over.
It bursts through the walls. The ceiling caves in when it emerges.
보석 박힌 지팡이로 내리쳤다: struck down with a jeweled staff
부러진 깃대들을 엮은 팔로 후려쳤다: lashed out with arms woven of broken standard poles
A fragment of a broken apostle's wing, hardened into mana stone. It seeps away through cracks in the ward.
불과 얼음의 경계에 사는 불도롱뇽들의 어미. 3라운드마다 불꽃을 뿜고,: Mother of the Fire Salamanders, dwelling where fire meets ice. Every 3 rounds it breathes flame, and when cornered it brings the cave down. Half of it is frozen.
Flame risen from a burning vein. It grows larger when the air stagnates.
비겁하다. 함정 근처에 숨어 있다가 함정을 밟은 상대를 노린다. 함정이: Cowardly. It hides near traps and preys on whoever steps on one. If the trap is disarmed, it flees.
Its scales are mana stone. It soon flees into the dark.
빛이 들어찬 장검을 내리쳤다: brought down a longsword brimming with light
사슬 끊긴 향로가 저절로 흔들리며 떠다닌다. 연기를 들이마시면 머리가 흐: A censer with a broken chain drifts about, swinging on its own. Breathing its smoke clouds the mind.
Swallowed mana stones glow like pearls inside it. It soon flees into the water.
Its wounds quickly freeze shut and heal. Burned by fire, it cannot heal that round.
They fly in swarms through the coal dust, embers clinging to their wingtips.
Lord of the island. He does not age. Those eyes are not human.
성당 신자들의 기도가 굳어 생긴 밀랍 인형. 셋이 함께 기도하며 서로를: Wax figures formed from the hardened prayers of Cathedral worshippers. They pray in threes, guiding one another.
A heretic hunter sent by the Cathedral. It follows heretics even into the Labyrinth.
성배가 통째로 마석이다. 그 빛은 옛 신의 기척을 조금 깎는다. 금세 날: The whole grail is mana stone. Its light wears away a little of the Old Gods' presence. It soon flies off.
성인의 뼈가 든 함이 떠다닌다. 그 빛에 닿으면 옛 신의 기척이 깎여 나: A casket holding a saint's bones drifts about. Its light wears away the Old Gods' presence.
성인의 이름을 외치며 철퇴를 내리쳤다: brought down a mace, crying a saint's name
속이 빈 성기사 갑옷에 빛이 들어찼다. 줄지어 서 있다가 한꺼번에 움직인: Hollow paladin armor filled with light. They stand in ranks, then move all at once.
썩은 사제복 안에서 자란 균사가 옛 기도를 흉내 낸다. 그 기도에 곰팡이: Mycelium grown inside rotting priest's robes mimics old prayers. At those prayers, the molds revive.
어둠 속에서 떼로 할퀴었다: swarmed and clawed from the dark
An ancient wraith trapped in an ice vein. Whatever its hand touches freezes.
A spirit congealed from the mana stone of an ice vein. It soon vanishes into the ice.
얼음 덩어리 같은 주먹을 휘둘렀다: swung a fist like a block of ice
여러 얼굴이 엉긴 몸으로 덮쳤다: lunged with a body of tangled faces
The Lord's hounds, who come to collect adventurers who have turned eighteen.
What emerged after shedding the Lord's skin. The very hand of the one who devoured its Consort.
영주의 문장이 새겨진 철퇴를 내리쳤다: brought down a mace bearing the Lord's crest
옛 신들이 세운 돌 수호자. 적이 아니라 시험관이다. 이기면 문을 열고,: A stone guardian raised by the Old Gods. Not an enemy, but an examiner. Win, and it opens the gate; lose, and it sets you down outside.
It crawls out of lava pools. Near groundwater, it lies hidden underwater and ambushes.
위에서 떨어진 뼈·녹슨 창·석상 조각이 엉겨 움직인다. 쥐의 이빨, 장군: Bones, rusted spears and statue fragments fallen from above, clumped together and moving. A rat's teeth, the General's insignia and the Fungal Mother's spores are mixed in.
유령 군마 위에서 장검을 내리쳤다: swung a longsword down from its ghost warhorse
A wraith general astride a Ghost Warhorse. Every 3 rounds it orders an advance.
유일신에게 먹힌 작은 옛 신들의 잔해. 상처가 저절로 메워진다. 쓰러뜨리: Remnants of lesser Old Gods devoured by the One God. Its wounds close on their own. Fell it, and one of their names returns.
유일신이 짝신을 삼키고 얻은 빛이 결계 틈으로 뻗어 나온 몸. 얼굴 자리: A body of the light the One God gained by devouring the Consort, reaching through a crack in the ward. Where its face should be, the Consort's face shows through. Every 3 rounds, radiance; when felled, it rises once more and swallows divine power.
이빨 고리로 갈아 냈다: ground at you with rings of teeth
이빨 달린 기도문 조각들이 떼 지어 날아다닌다. 성가의 박자에 맞춰 문다: Scraps of prayer with teeth fly about in swarms. They bite in time with the hymn.
이빨 달린 종잇조각으로 베었다: slashed with toothed scraps of paper
Grown fat on battlefield corpses. They come in flocks of 4~6, going for the eyes.
Riderless, it still runs the battlefield. Its first charge is the deadliest.
참회하던 자들을 묶던 사슬이 스스로 움직인다. 감기면 쉽게 빠져나오지 못: Chains that once bound penitents, moving of their own accord. Once wrapped, you will not easily slip free.
천장에서 내려온 눈이 빛을 쏟았다: an eye descending from the ceiling poured down light
The whole candelabrum is mana stone. After three flickers it goes out.
In murky water it latches onto legs. It sucks blood, and its saliva numbs the flesh.
Every hair glitters with mana stone dust. Timid.
포자 덩어리를 내리쳤다: slammed down a mass of spores
They roam the grass in packs. They grow fiercer at night.
The slime on its skin is poison. Touch the slime it sprays when it bursts and your body goes numb.
하늘에서 내려꽂힌다. 칼이 잘 닿지 않고, 비명은 머리를 어지럽힌다. 밤: It dives from the sky. Hard to reach with a blade, and its shriek scrambles the mind. At night it returns to its nest.
Queen of the Harpies. Her shriek tears through the mind. She wears a feathered mantle.
허기진 입으로 물어뜯었다: tore in with a starving mouth
It has studded its body with stolen mana stones. At the first sign of trouble, it flees.
흰 회랑 천장에서 내려오는 거대한 눈과 날개. 신전에 오래 머무는 자를: A colossal eye and wings descending from the ceiling of the white cloister. It watches those who linger in the Temple. Its gaze does not reach the Shrine (Floor 3).
흰빛이 된 손으로 내리눌렀다: bore down with a hand turned to white light
